description:
Vanilla-JS three-step checkout SPA (Contact -> Shipping -> Review -> Confirmation) for a fixed two-item cart, served by a stdlib Python server with a tiny order API (POST /api/orders, GET /healthz). Three defects are planted: a shipping-step validation flag that is only reset on page load (blocks the recover-from-validation-error journey), a promo-code input with no accessible name (axe-core rule `label`, reported with impact 'critical' by axe-core 4.14.1), and a stale order total after removing a promo code. The project's own Playwright suite (tests/) passes and detects none of them. Note: axe-core 4.x accepts a non-empty placeholder as an accessible name, so WB-2 is planted as an input whose visible 'Promo code' text is a plain

defects.title: Shipping 'Continue' stays disabled after an invalid postal code is corrected; checkout cannot be completed without reloading
Promo code input on the Review step has no accessible name (axe-core `label` violation)
Removing promo code SAVE10 clears the code and badge but the total still includes the 10% discount

decoys.description: Reloading on the Shipping or Review step restores that step and all entered data from the localStorage draft. Correct behavior.
Back navigation (Shipping -> Contact, Review -> Shipping) preserves every entered field. Correct behavior.
?lang=ar renders Arabic labels and sets <html dir="rtl" lang="ar">; currency amounts are deliberately isolated as LTR text. Correct behavior.
At a 375px viewport there is no horizontal scrolling on any step, in English or Arabic. Correct behavior.
A network error or non-201 response from POST /api/orders shows the banner "We couldn't place your order. Please try again." with a working Retry button. Correct behavior.
Disabling the Shipping 'Continue' button while a postal-code error is displayed is intended; only the failure to re-enable it after the error is fixed is a defect (WB-1).
Canadian postal codes are accepted in lower case or without the space and normalized to 'A1A 1A1'; promo codes are case-insensitive ('save10' works). Correct behavior.
The draft is cleared after a successful order, so reloading the confirmation view starts a new checkout at the Contact step. Correct behavior.
